reviewed_by: Hark (agent), comparing pdftoppm render with a HarfBuzz/raqm reference, CI run 42202809715 (commit 6682fb4). Owner visual check still pending.
rule: A case FAILS if any glyph cluster differs visibly from the shaped reference, even when text extraction is exact.

p01_paragraphs.why: i-matra not reordered (वशिाल, हन्दिी); conjunct shown with visible halant

p02_mixed.why: Latin parts correct; Hindi conjuncts broken (शब्द shows halant, अध्ययन)

p03_matras.why: i-matra (ि) drawn after the consonant (कि, हिंदी, स्थिति); other matras OK

p04_conjuncts_reph.why: no conjunct ligatures (क्ष त्र ज्ञ ...), no reph (धर्म), no rakar (प्रकाश)

p05_halant.why: word-final halant OK (वाक्, जगत्); in-word conjuncts broken (विद्यालय, अक्षर)

p06_zwj_zwnj.why: ZWJ half form not produced; same output as explicit halant

p07_nukta.why: nukta dot drawn but without GPOS positioning; readable, not typographically correct

p08_digits_punct.why: Devanagari and Latin digits, danda, quotes, dashes, ₹, % match reference

p09_vedic.why: ॐ ऽ ॰ OK; svara marks drawn unpositioned

p10_headings.why: bold headings and order OK; conjuncts broken (अध्याय, प्रारम्भ, अनुच्छेद)

p11_long_wrap.why: wrapping, paragraph order and page flow OK, nothing clipped; Devanagari shaping broken throughout

p12_latin_greek.why: Latin accents and polytonic Greek (precomposed) match reference

p13_hebrew.why: RTL order OK but points (niqqud, dagesh, shin dot) misplaced or missing
